hook_line: DEMOCRATS VOW TO REIN IN TRUMP'S IMMIGRATION CRACKDOWN

hook_stat.sub: Trump's approval on immigration in Reuters/Ipsos polling, down from 50% at the start of his presidency

stats.label: Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress in last week's midterms
More than $100 billion allocated to DHS — Democrats plan greater transparency into how it is spent

diaspora_bullets: For immigrants in the US: nothing changes today
The practical fight in 2027 is oversight, funding leverage and hearings
news_summary: Democratic lawmakers, who won control of both chambers of Congress in last week's midterms, plan to target ICE tactics and expand paths to legal status when the new Congress convenes, Reuters reports.
payoff: For immigrants in the US, nothing changes today — the practical fight in 2027 is oversight, not an immediate change in enforcement.
